name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 仮面ライダーディケイド

description.ja: 色分け再現にこだわり、ライダーカード26種を含む豊富なオプションパーツが付属した「仮面ライダーディケイド」がFigure-rise Standardに登場！
description.en: "Kamen Rider Decade", which is particular about color-coded reproduction and comes with a wealth of optional parts including 26 types of rider cards, is now available in Figure-rise Standard!

description.ja: • プラモデルならではのパーツ分割により変身シーンをイメージした頭部の組み立てが可能。
description.en: • By dividing the parts unique to plastic models, it is possible to assemble the head based on the image of the transformation scene.

description.ja: • ライドブッカーは剣形態、銃形態、携行形態の３種をそれぞれ組み立て可能。
description.en: • Ride Booker can be assembled into three types: sword form, gun form, and carrying form.

description.ja: • ベルトに装填可能なPET素材のライダーカードが26種付属。
description.en: • Includes 26 types of PET material rider cards that can be loaded onto the belt.

description.ja: • ベルトを他のFigure-rise Standard 仮面ライダーシリーズに取り付けできるアダプター付属。
description.en: • Comes with an adapter that allows you to attach the belt to other Figure-rise Standard Kamen Rider series.

description.ja: • ネオディケイドライバーも付属。
description.en: • Neo Decay Driver is also included.

accessories.ja: ライドブッカー（携行形態/銃形態/剣形態）×各1
accessories.en: Ride Booker (portable form/gun form/sword form) x 1 each

accessories.ja: ネオディケイドライバー×1
手首パーツ 握り手(左右)、平手(左右)、武器持ち手(右手)、カード保持用持ち手(右手)
accessories.en: Wrist parts: gripping hand (left and right), open hand (left and right), weapon holder (right hand), card holding hand (right hand)

accessories.ja: フィギュアライズエフェクト台座×1
